description: This file defines an abstract base class for setting up and managing a test cluster environment in Orleans, including initialization, disposal, and precondition checks.

classes.name: BaseTestClusterFixture
classes.description: An abstract class providing setup, configuration, and cleanup for Orleans test clusters, implementing asynchronous lifecycle methods.

methods.name: EnsurePreconditionsMet
methods.description: Checks if preconditions for the test cluster are met, throwing stored exceptions if not.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Virtual method intended to be overridden to implement precondition checks before cluster setup.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Virtual method intended to be overridden to customize the test cluster configuration.

methods.name: GetClientServiceId
methods.description: Retrieves the ServiceId from the cluster client's service provider options.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the test cluster, deploying it if necessary, and sets up logging.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the test cluster, stopping all silos and cleaning up resources.
